checks.name: 삼성증권 발행 상장중 ETN 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETN' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '삼성증권%'

checks.name: 삼성증권 ETN 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETN' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '삼성증권%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 10

checks.name: 상위 10종목 비중 합계
checks.sql: SELECT round(sum(w), 2) FROM (SELECT TRY_CAST(replace(COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS w FROM etf_constituent WHERE etf_isin='KR7069500007' ORDER BY w DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10)

checks.name: 공통 종목 수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM etf_constituent c1 JOIN etf_constituent c2 ON c1.COMPST_ISU_CD=c2.COMPST_ISU_CD WHERE c1.etf_isin='KR7102110004' AND c2.etf_isin='KR7069500007' AND trim(coalesce(c1.COMPST_ISU_CD,'')) <> ''

checks.name: 듀레이션 5년 이상 채권 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE TRY_CAST(DUR AS DOUBLE) >= 5

checks.name: 현대차 5% 초과 편입 ETF 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT coalesce(e.pd_abrv_nm, c.etf_name) AS pd_abrv_nm, c.etf_name FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin = e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005380' AND TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) > 5 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

checks.name: 총보수 하위(값 보유분)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: '채권' 표기 ETF 순자산 1조 초과
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%채권%' AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) > 1000000000000 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 10

checks.name: 총보수 합 1% 초과 펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE (coalesce(TRY_CAST(sale_co_rwrd_r AS DOUBLE), 0) + coalesce(TRY_CAST(or_co_rwrd_r AS DOUBLE), 0) + coalesce(TRY_CAST(trusc_rwrd_r AS DOUBLE), 0) + coalesce(TRY_CAST(ofwk_trus_rwrd_r AS DOUBLE), 0)) > 1
